the velocity characteristics of dilute solid-liquid flow were investigated by Particle Dynamic Analyzer.The results showed that there were significant differences between the single-phase and two-phase flow.The velocity profiles for two phase flow were similar with single-phase in impeller region.The turbulence levels were about 50% reduction than those of the single phase flow in the impelle rregion.The axial velocities of two-phase flows were higher than corresponding single-phase flow,while the tangential velocities of two phase flow decreased with increasing the particle concentration

the velocity characteristics of solid-liquid flows in stirred tank were investigated by PDA.The results showed that axial velocities for two phase flow were higher than those of the single phase flow in the impelling region,and the turbulence levels decreased with the increase of solid concentration.
